people.role: Keeper of the founder's rain-chain at the Rain Tower
people.backstory: Born under the founder's chain at the old seat, she oils its nine cups each Kinh Trập for Quan Vũ Thanh (quan_vu_thanh) and has said she will sit beneath it with her sword if the ridge ever sends men to take it down.

ties.note: taught her at the old tower before the halls moved
the other sword the Rain Tower kept
cone-born outer disciple at the Rain Tower

tree.intent: A Metal sword that waits a long time and cuts once.

people.appearance: Polishes the bronze cup at her neck as she talks.

people.role: Steward of the Rain Tower's cisterns and the south's grain tax
people.backstory: A grain factor's son from Không Mông who weighs the south's tax in kind (A288) at the Rain Tower and sends the ridge its barley a little late each autumn, which the Hall of Rules notices. In the bad winter of 1197 he took the Phong Đăng tenants' seed barley by the book.

ties.note: the envoy who took him into the Rain faction
the seat's stores clerk counts his barley twice
boatman of the Rain Tower on the lotus lake
cistern servant (tạp dịch) of the Rain Tower for eighty years
steward of the mule road that carries the south's barley up to the ridge

tree.intent: Water wards for a steward who would rather not fight.

people.appearance: A scale-beam tattooed on one wrist, and grain dust in the creases of his neck.

people.role: Rows the dead out to the withered lotus at Tàn Hà Hồ
people.backstory: Of the grand elder's family five generations down, she rows each rain burial out to the founder's lotus and lowers the body herself; Lư Tàn Hà (lu_tan_ha) reads the name and she repeats it to the water.

ties.note: the grand elder of her family
from the same village; they keep the lake graves together
lake-grave keeper's daughter at Tàn Hà Hồ

tree.intent: Metal guard that holds still on water.

people.appearance: Oar-callused hands that never shake; a mourning-white cord at her wrist.

people.role: Draws the bronze wire for the Iron Rain chain at the storm forge
people.backstory: Drew every link of the Iron Rain chain (N-thinh_vu-10) for Thạch Liên Hoàn (thach_lien_hoan) in 1170, and walks its length to Kinh Lôi Mạch each month with a hammer, listening for a link that rings wrong.

ties.note: the forge master
guards the chain's end at the vein
casts the bronze cups new disciples wear at the neck

tree.intent: Heavy Metal blades and the forge.

people.appearance: Taps every link of the chain with a hammer as he passes.

people.role: Night watch of the life lamps in the soul vaults
people.backstory: A Tử Tinh miner's daughter who trims the lamps' wicks through the night and knows each lamp by its flicker; she once counted them against the roll, and Ninh Tịch Đăng (ninh_tich_dang) told her to stop counting.

ties.note: keeper of the lamps
the vaults' copyist
carries oil for the life lamps
her nephew; outer disciple from Tử Tinh Khoáng with a Thunder root

people.appearance: Hair pinned up with a wick-trimmer, and pupils as wide as an owl's.

people.role: Listener of the Hall of Echoes in the harbour taverns of Lãng Hoa
people.backstory: Plays dice in Lãng Hoa's harbour taverns and loses carefully; what the pirate-hunters' crews say when they win goes north to Nhiếp Vô Thanh (nhiep_vo_thanh), folded into the coast house's fish accounts.

ties.note: the spymistress
keeps the coast house he reports through

tree.intent: Quiet Water and darts thrown once.

people.appearance: Dice-callused fingertips, an easy loser's smile, and a front tooth missing.

people.role: Reader of the Hall of Rules: keeps the sect rules and reads the charge at trials
people.backstory: Reads the charge at every trial the Hall of Echoes brings, in the dark and by heart; Thái Canh Lậu (thai_canh_lau) says the water clock drips louder than he speaks. He adds or drops a clause of the charge as the clock drips, and no one has dared check; a salt-carrier got three years for a clause he dropped in the dark.

ties.note: master of the Hall of Rules
keeps the clock while he keeps the rules

people.appearance: Reads in the dark with his eyes half closed; his voice is lower than the water clock.

people.role: The War Hall's pace-setter on the storm climb of Liệt Khuyết Phong
people.backstory: Has climbed Liệt Khuyết Phong in every first storm since 1166 and come down each time (A316); Phương Đoạn Vũ (phuong_doan_vu) makes the others keep his pace, and Mục Trập Sinh (muc_trap_sinh) thinks it will kill a weaker boy. He kept his pace when one boy's ankle broke, and the boy went down the peak on a litter.

ties.note: the drillmaster
the drill sergeant who would slow the climb
outer disciple who wants to climb Liệt Khuyết Phong with the inner gate

tree.intent: A Metal sword raised into the storm.

people.appearance: Calves like rope, and a rain-streaked face that nothing bothers.

people.role: Weigher of the Night Rain Market and keeper of the guest stalls' leases
people.backstory: Kiều Mãn Lâu's (kieu_man_lau) niece, she took up the abacus her cousin Kiều Tiểu Vũ (kieu_tieu_vu) refused, and would like it noticed that she did; she pockets the copper tip from each weighing though Hoắc Thu Lan (hoac_thu_lan) writes the weights.

ties.note: the market master
her father's brother
wants the sword, leaves her the scales
clerk of the Night Rain Market's scales

tree.intent: Water and seals for a trader.

people.appearance: A bone abacus at her belt, and a bracelet of weights that chimes when she moves.

people.role: Sorts the rain-flower pebbles at Vũ Hoa Khoáng
people.backstory: Phương Đoạn Vũ (phuong_doan_vu) came from her mine and taught her on his visits home; she sorts the pebbles for the market under her uncle Ông Vũ Hoa (ong_vu_hoa) and has no wish to see the ridge.

ties.note: taught her on his visits home
her mother's brother, the warden

people.appearance: A pebble in her cheek that she thinks no one has noticed.

people.role: Holds the outer door of the soul vaults under Kinh Lôi Mạch
people.backstory: Has asked Lệ Tiêu Hồn (le_tieu_hon) to be taught the Thunder Hall's arts and been told he must first hold Thunder, which he does not; he holds the door instead.

ties.note: master of the vaults
the other guard on the vein
gate boy of the soul vaults

people.appearance: Stands with his back to the door and one hand on the latch; the latch has come off in that hand twice.

people.role: Writes the Rain faction's letters home from the ridge
people.backstory: Chose the rain burial in writing and pinned the paper to the Hall of Rules' door so the count would show it; Tôn Tuyệt Bích (ton_tuyet_bich) took it down, and she pinned it back.

ties.note: the envoy
the ridge's coldest sword, who calls her soft
Tôn Tuyệt Bích's shadow in the practice yard

tree.intent: Water sword that turns blows aside.

people.appearance: Ink on her left sleeve, a paper fold at her belt, and a jaw that sets when she is crossed.

people.role: Young Thunder sword of the Thunder Hall
people.backstory: Hauled ore at Sa Kim until his Thunder woke; he passed the Bell Test the same spring as Đoàn Kim Sa (doan_kim_sa) and wants it known that only one of them hears the vein. He carries Đoàn Kim Sa's drill notes to Lệ Tiêu Hồn for a hearing, and Đoàn Kim Sa (doan_kim_sa) lost his place at the vein drill when the notes were found copied.

ties.note: true disciple of the Thunder Hall
same mine, same spring, no Thunder

people.appearance: Ore-hauler's sloping shoulders, and eyes that follow other men's swords.

people.role: Steward of the mule road that carries the south's barley up to the ridge
people.backstory: Has walked the barley up from Hạnh Hoa Thị since the halls moved in 1166, and before that walked it the other way; at a hundred and seventy he counts his remaining trips, and Tào Mặc Toán (tao_mac_toan) counts his sacks. One sack in thirty of the barley is not on his stick-marks; his old mule eats it, and Trịnh Cam Đường (trinh_cam_duong) bakes the ridge's bread a loaf short.

ties.note: the Hall of Rules
loads the barley at the Rain Tower
keeps the seat's kitchen fire, which goes out at dusk

tree.intent: Earth for a body that walks.

people.appearance: Talks to his stick, under a barley-sack hat.

people.role: Teaches the outer gate the drop-counting drill before the Bell Test
people.backstory: Passed the Bell Test on Metal; his little sister Âu Tiểu Linh (au_tieu_linh) holds the Thunder he does not and may never pass it, and he drills her harder than the rest.

ties.note: the Hall of Rules
his younger sister in the outer gate
outer disciple from the apricot market

people.appearance: A drop-counter's slow blink, and a pebble bag at his hip.

people.role: Sweeps the founder's cistern at the Rain Tower
people.backstory: Born in the cone village below the old tower, she was sent back down after one winter on the ridge to serve under Lộ Tiêm Tiêm (lo_tiem_tiem), and is glad of it.

ties.note: Rain faction sword at the old tower

people.appearance: Forearms like a stair-sweeper's, hem always wet.

people.role: Quan Vũ Thanh's grand-nephew at the Rain Tower
people.backstory: Quan Vũ Thanh (quan_vu_thanh) is of his family's line, and he expects the old tower to remember it; La Tố Y (la_to_y) takes him on her courier rounds to teach him otherwise. He has never once carried his own bag.

ties.note: the courier
the elder of his family's line

people.appearance: An embroidered rain cap with the Quan crest, a size too bright, and hands that have never carried a bag.

people.role: Cistern servant (tạp dịch) of the Rain Tower for eighty years
people.backstory: Has scrubbed the Rain Tower's cisterns since 1120, when the old seat held every hall; he still sets a straw hat at the door for each elder who moved east.

ties.note: the cistern steward

tree.intent: Water for a long life of work.

people.exception: servant (tạp dịch): a Water root with no Metal or Fire, kept for the cisterns
people.appearance: Hunched, gap-toothed, humming to the cisterns.

people.role: Outer disciple kept at the old tower
people.backstory: A Thu Trì boatman's daughter who chose the rain burial in her first week, before anyone asked; Hà Lạc Vũ (ha_lac_vu) keeps her at the old tower rather than send her up the ridge.

ties.note: Rain faction disciple
the other southern girl at the tower

tree.intent: Water, toward the Rain faction's guard.

people.appearance: Hair in a boatman's knot, and a faded rope burn across one palm.

people.role: Cone-born outer disciple who helps tend the lightning burns
people.backstory: Cát Liên Châu's (cat_lien_chau) elder brother; both entered on Fire and neither will pass the Bell Test, and he has stopped sitting it to hold the burn salves for Bồ Ngọc Châm (bo_ngoc_cham).

ties.note: tends the storm-drill burns
his younger sister

tree.intent: Fire for salves and the furnace.

people.appearance: Big and pale; he stops on the stair to get his breath back, and his hands are very clean from the salves.

people.role: Bellows boy at the storm forge
people.backstory: Works the bellows at Tử Kim Khoáng for Thạch Vũ Liên (thach_vu_lien) and has burned off his eyebrows twice; Mã Thiết Câu (ma_thiet_cau) keeps count.

ties.note: the forge master's daughter
the other forge boy

people.appearance: No eyebrows at all, and he is already working on a third attempt.

people.role: Casts the bronze cups new disciples wear at the neck
people.backstory: Casts every bronze cup the Tower gives on a joining day and stamps each with a mark only she can read, so she knows which cups the lightning has melted; Bành Chú Thiết (banh_chu_thiet) taught her the moulds.

ties.note: the wire drawer

people.appearance: Sleeves rolled to the elbow, and mould sand in her hair.

people.role: Picks rain-flower pebbles from the stream at Vũ Hoa Khoáng
people.backstory: Has never seen the ridge; Ông Vũ Hoa (ong_vu_hoa) took him into the gate on Metal 44 so the mine would keep him.

ties.note: the warden
the other mine boy

people.appearance: Looks about twelve; smells of wet gravel and keeps a pebble behind each ear.

people.role: Outer disciple from Tử Tinh Khoáng with a Thunder root
people.backstory: Mạc Tinh Lôi's (mac_tinh_loi) nephew, Thunder from the same mine; his aunt has told him not to show it at the Bell Test, since it counts for nothing there. He means to show it at the Bell Test anyway, and has told his aunt the opposite; she covered his lamp shift for the week he spent practising.

ties.note: keeps the amethyst seams
his father's sister, in the vaults

tree.intent: Thunder, once the Metal holds it.

people.appearance: A splinter of thunder-glass on a cord round his wrist.

people.role: Carries the War Hall's practice swords up Liệt Khuyết Phong
people.backstory: Wrestles Bì Thiết Nha (bi_thiet_nha) every Kinh Trập for the title of the outer gate's strongest boy and has lost four years running; Mục Trập Sinh (muc_trap_sinh) bets on him anyway.

ties.note: the drill sergeant
the outer gate's strongest boy

tree.intent: Metal body and a heavy sword.

people.appearance: Squashed wrestler's ear, bruises in three colours, a face that still hopes.

people.role: The oldest outer disciple on the ridge
people.backstory: Sat the Bell Test every Kinh Trập since 1114 and heard the bell answer once, faintly; Bộc Thủ Chung (boc_thu_chung), who entered the same spring and passed, lets him keep the practice yard.

ties.note: entered the gate the same spring

people.appearance: White-bearded, in an outer disciple's grey that his dignity does not quite fill; the bell has rung for him once.

people.role: Keeps the seat's kitchen fire, which goes out at dusk
people.backstory: Puts the kitchen fire out at dusk by the Night Rain rule and lights it again at dawn; Hồ Bách Lý (ho_bach_ly) brings her the barley, and they have argued about the ridge's bread for thirty years. She hands out the bread by her mood, and the ridge has learned to read her face; Đồng Vũ Thạch (dong_vu_thach) went three days without.

ties.note: brings the barley up the road

people.appearance: A poker on her hip, forearms like loaves, and soot to the eyebrows.

people.role: Runner for the Hall of Echoes between the ridge and Hạnh Hoa Thị
people.backstory: Carries Lăng Ngân Lộ's (lang_ngan_lo) sealed reeds down to Hạnh Hoa Thị and back without opening them, and has learned the shapes of the knots instead; he tells Lăng Ngân Lộ (lang_ngan_lo) the seals are whole, and road men who knew her knot beat her once.

ties.note: runner of the Hall of Echoes

people.appearance: An ordinary brown coat that no one ever remembers having seen.

people.role: Outer disciple at the Tower's coast house in Lãng Hoa
people.backstory: A fishwife's daughter who keeps the coast house's fish accounts for Hoàng Tiêu Diệp (hoang_tieu_diep) and has not asked why some pages are folded twice. She keeps back one fish in twenty of the accounts for herself, and the shortfall is written against Chu Ngọc Trích's (chu_ngoc_trich) page.

ties.note: keeps the coast house
the other outer disciple at Lãng Hoa

people.appearance: Fish-scale glitter in her hair, and a chatter that never dries up.

people.role: Ferry boy at the Thu Trì inn of the Hall of Echoes
people.backstory: Carries guests' bags up from the Thu Trì ferry and repeats what they say to Lục Nhĩ Thính (luc_nhi_thinh) for a copper a sentence, including a pilgrim's whispered grief for a drowned son, which was read out to the ridge.

ties.note: keeps the ferry inn

people.appearance: Jug-eared, with a ferry-rope sling over one shoulder.

people.role: Clerk of the Night Rain Market's scales
people.backstory: Writes the weights Kiều Ngân Châu (kieu_ngan_chau) calls out at the market and has caught one desert trader's false stone, which made her famous for a week.

ties.note: the market's weigher

people.appearance: A bone weight on a cord round her neck that she has never lost.

people.role: Lake-grave keeper's daughter at Tàn Hà Hồ
people.backstory: Her family has poled the burial boat on Tàn Hà Hồ for six generations; Lư Hà Tịnh (lu_ha_tinh) took her into the gate so the boat would have a cultivator at the oar.

ties.note: rows the dead out

people.appearance: Long arms, a rower's posture, and a gaze that does not blink.

people.role: Cone girl admitted on Fire, who reads the clouds for the drills
people.backstory: From Lâm Linh Đỉnh on the cone, where the ash clouds turn the rain to thunder; Vi Quan Vân (vi_quan_van) takes her to read the storms because she sees them coming a day early; she tells him she reads it in the clouds, and lets the goatherd who really warns her go unthanked through every storm.

ties.note: reads the storms for the drills

people.appearance: Her face turned up to the sky, a cloud-grey ribbon in her hair.

people.role: Keeps the water clock's cistern full at night
people.backstory: From Thảo Lư Thôn like his master Thái Canh Lậu (thai_canh_lau), he climbs to the clock cistern twice a night in the dark and has never spilled a bucket.

ties.note: keeps the water clock

people.appearance: A bucket on each shoulder, and a night-walker's silent step.

people.role: Tallies the salted meat and barley in the seat's stores
people.backstory: Tallies the seat's stores for Tào Mặc Toán (tao_mac_toan), who checks her sums against a second ledger he keeps in his sleeve and has never shown her.

ties.note: the stores clerk

people.appearance: An abacus bead strung on her braid, and ink-black thumbs.

people.role: Outer disciple who wants to climb Liệt Khuyết Phong with the inner gate
people.backstory: Follows Cung Trảm Vân (cung_tram_van) up the first stretch of Liệt Khuyết Phong every storm until he is sent down, and goes a little further each time.

ties.note: the War Hall's pace-setter

people.appearance: His chin always lifted toward the peak; he cannot wait at the foot of anything.

people.role: Xuyên Lâm Môn's servant (tạp dịch), sent with its hostage
people.backstory: Came up from Xuyên Lâm Môn with Úc Đả Diệp (uc_da_diep) in 1170 to cook his meals; the Hall of Echoes has listened to him for thirty years and heard almost nothing.

ties.note: the hostage he was sent to serve

tree.intent: Wood for a servant's long days.

people.exception: servant (tạp dịch) of Xuyên Lâm Môn's hostage; not taught the lineage
people.appearance: Bald and silent, with a cook's burn-scarred hands; his ears seem to listen on their own.

people.role: Outer disciple from the apricot market
people.backstory: An apricot seller's girl from Hạnh Hoa Thị who knows Lục Du's poem of the small tower by heart; Âu Hành Vân (au_hanh_van), from the same market, drills her drop-counting.

ties.note: teaches the drop-counting drill

people.appearance: Folds a scrap of poem into her sleeve and hums when she thinks.

people.role: Gate boy of the soul vaults
people.backstory: Born in the ruin of Thủ Lôi Bảo under the new seat, he stands at the vault door beside Trác Kinh Phong (trac_kinh_phong) and has learned to name each elder by the sound of their steps.

ties.note: holds the vault door

people.appearance: Cocks his head at every footstep, a ruin-dust smudge on his chin.

people.role: Carries oil for the life lamps
people.backstory: Carries the lamp oil down into the vaults, the only lit place in the Tower, and is afraid of the dark everywhere else; Mạc Tinh Lôi (mac_tinh_loi) lets her sit the night watch with her.

ties.note: night watch of the lamps

people.appearance: Walks with one hand on the wall, a thimble of lamp oil in her sleeve.

people.role: Farm girl from Phong Đăng who carries the grain tax
people.backstory: Entered on Metal 30 exactly, like Thiều Mộ Vũ (thieu_mo_vu) before her; she carries the grain tax (A288) to the Rain Tower and thinks the ridge should eat rice.

ties.note: courier of the old tower
from the same farms

people.appearance: Grain-sack calluses across both shoulders, and she thinks aloud about rice.

people.role: Cone-born outer disciple at the Rain Tower
people.backstory: Wears her rain hat indoors as the Rain Tower does and has never once taken it off at the ridge; Tần Liên Âm (tan_lien_am) lets her hold the ladder when the chain is oiled.

ties.note: keeper of the founder's chain

people.appearance: A wide rain hat that hides everything but her mouth.

people.role: Boatman of the Rain Tower on the lotus lake
people.backstory: Poles the Rain Tower's boats on the lake below the cone and has given up on Foundation; Phí Thanh Giang (phi_thanh_giang) pays him in rice wine and says it is the tax.

ties.note: the cistern steward

people.appearance: A bald crown and a long, wind-cracked face like a boiled turnip; the boatmen call him Radish to his face.

people.role: Tôn Tuyệt Bích's shadow in the practice yard
people.backstory: Copies Tôn Tuyệt Bích's (ton_tuyet_bich) single cut so closely that the War Hall tells them apart by height; she thinks the south is soft and says so at the Rain Tower's table.

ties.note: Cố Dạ Lan's youngest disciple
the Rain faction's letter-writer

people.appearance: Copies Tôn Tuyệt Bích down to the sleeve; the War Hall tells them apart only by height.

people.role: Carries the vaults' copies to the seat
people.backstory: A cone girl who carries Giang Hạnh Hoa's (giang_hanh_hoa) copies between the vaults and the seat; she chose the thunder burial in writing, though she holds no Thunder, because it is the ridge's, and sold a night's glimpse of the copies to a Hạnh Hoa broker for a ribbon, so that Giang Hạnh Hoa (giang_hanh_hoa) was blamed for the leak.

ties.note: copyist of the soul vaults

people.appearance: A satchel strap across her chest, and a foot that never stops tapping.
